root_idea.summary: The root develops two related orientations: contention between opposing parties, and the side or edge of a container or thing.
root_idea.development: The lexical tradition presents disputation and the side of an object as two principal branches, and relates them through the idea of taking an opposing side or being situated at a side.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
Displayed as the distinct Form VI verbal noun.
The Quranic plural adjective is presented under its singular dictionary citation form.
Displayed as the QAC lemma group containing both خَصِيم and خِصَام, with their distinct senses separated below.
Displayed under the normalized singular noun خَصْم.

senses.definition: To contend with one another, dispute, or litigate.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VIII verb for opposing parties engaged in contention or litigation.
A verbal noun describing the state or act of parties disputing with one another; it can include litigation.

senses.definition: Contentious, argumentative, or given to disputation.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural خَصِمُونَ describes those characterized by or engaged in الخصومة, rather than merely identifying a party to a dispute.

senses.definition: A disputant or opponent, especially one who frequently engages in contention.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense belongs to خَصِيم, a personal noun for a person characterized by frequent disputation.
This sense belongs to the Quranic verbal noun خِصَام within the same QAC lemma group; it denotes disputation rather than a disputing person.

senses.definition: An opponent, adversary, or litigant; a party in contention.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may be used for a male or female, and may occur in singular, dual, or plural usage. In the Quran it can designate opposing parties or litigants collectively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend in an altercation, dispute, or litigation in a valid or sound manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An unaugmented Form I verb; the cited description emphasizes proper or sound disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with, dispute with, or litigate against someone; in one usage, to prevail over him in the dispute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form III construction with a person as the object of contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Argumentative speech intended to make an interlocutor desist from an assertion, plea, or claim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized interpretation of خِصَام as the effective statement used in contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put something at the edge or side of a bed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form III construction with the edge or side of the bed as the relevant location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dictate to someone a plea against his adversary so that he may overcome the adversary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV construction involving the preparation or delivery of another person's legal or disputatious plea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring a dispute before an adjudicator, with each party claiming the right.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an adjudicator as the destination of the litigants' application for a decision.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side, edge, corner, or lateral part of a thing, including the side or corner of a load, container, cloud, or the part of the eye where the eyelids meet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete spatial noun covering the lateral portions of various objects and structures.
A figurative or extended usage, especially of an affair in which closing one gap opens another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mouths or openings of valleys.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural lexical usage referring to valley entrances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower parts or stocks of certain trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural usage for the bases of the trees called سَرَحَات.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Knowledgeable or skilled in altercation, or valid and sound in disputation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical adjectival specialization distinct from simply being actively contentious; it may describe ability or soundness in disputation even without current practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bead, gem, or similar amulet worn in connection with disputing or appearing before a ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun, also described as being placed beneath a signet gem, in a button, or on a sword cord.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The loop of a sack or of a load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for the loop of a جُوَالِق or an عِدْل.
